# Suvo

> Suvo is a supplement tracking app for cataloging a user's stack, reviewing supplement interaction and timing conflicts, and building a clearer supplement schedule.

Site: https://getsuvo.com/
Contact: hello@getsuvo.com
Language: en and de (German pages under /de/)
Price: free, no ads, no paywall (funded by affiliate links)
iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6764276451
Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.suvo.mobile

## What Suvo does

- Adds supplements by barcode scan, label-photo OCR, or name search
- Breaks multivitamins into individual compounds
- Flags supplement interactions and timing conflicts (for example iron with calcium or coffee)
- Warns when stacked products push a nutrient past its upper limit
- Sums each compound across all products in the stack and shows the total as a percentage of its recommended daily amount and of its upper limit
- Applies minimum-spacing timing rules between specific compound pairs (for example iron and calcium)
- Schedules morning, evening, and meal-time reminder slots with daily, every-other-day, weekly, and monthly cadences
- Tracks adherence streaks that respect each supplement's cadence
- Supports managed profiles for family members under one adult account
- Links to country-appropriate retailers (DE, UK, US, MEA)

## Source policy

Suvo's supplement rules are educational and are not medical advice. Interaction, timing, and upper-limit guidance is based on named source tiers: regulatory authorities, government institutes, systematic reviews, academic references, and curated databases. The public source library explains why each source is trusted and where it fits in the hierarchy.
